subject: Rapid deck iteration and OKR bridging plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Board Ops <board_ops@sequoia.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Rapid deck iteration and OKR bridging plan

Team — kicking off a compressed run to get the investor/board packet into a reviewable state by the end of next week. Key constraints: a) slide freeze for board narrative = EOD Wednesday 10/28; b) data appendix gated on final metrics extraction by Monday 10/26 5pm PT.

Top asks (please confirm owner inline):
- Narrative top-line (2 slides): confirm headline and 1-sentence ask for board (owner: Jonas?)
- OKR bridging slide: call out gaps against Q4 goals and proposed mitigation (owner: Marissa)
- Risk & escalation heatmap: add 2–3 mitigations and owners (owner: Laura)
- Data appendix: canonical numbers and 3-month trend charts (owner: Marissa + analytics)
- Final deck proof and export (owner: Neha)

Attachments: RB-Deck-v3.pptx (draft), OKR-runbook.xlsx (working), data-appendix.csv (raw export). Latest working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_Decks.

Immediate asks: please review RB-Deck-v3 and leave slide-level comments or a short inline edit by EOD Tuesday (10/27). If you cannot meet that cadence, reply with which slides you will own for finishing so I can reassign.

I want to avoid another wide redline cycle — plan is: collect edits Tue night, implement Wed morning, leadership review Wed afternoon, freeze Wed EOD, investor pre-read Thursday AM.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Strategy & Corporate Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: board_ops@sequoia.com

On 10/25/26 09:12, Neha Kapoor wrote:
> Team — kicking off a compressed run to get the investor/board packet into a reviewable state by the end of next week...

Thanks Neha — I can own the OKR bridging slide and the data appendix gating. Quick notes as I looked through RB-Deck-v3:
- Slide 6 (OKR gaps): needs a clearer call-to-action — I propose we present 3 mitigations per gap with owners and ETA.
- Slide 9 (Product adoption chart): raw export looks off — the cohort filter is including test orgs. I asked analytics to regenerate; expecting data-appendix.csv v2 by end of day.
- I updated shoulder copy on slides 2/3 (see comments) to orient the narrative to “predictable inference economics” rather than capacity.

I attached OKR-runbook.xlsx with the owners column filled for items I’ll close. If analytics doesn’t deliver by EOD Monday, we should call out the appendix as "preliminary" and include a short note on data gating so the board isn't blindsided.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OKR-runbook.xlsx (updated)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Rapid deck iteration and OKR bridging plan

Neha / Marissa — good plan. Two editorial asks from the exec summary perspective:
1) Move the competitive positioning slide (current slide 5) to the appendix and replace with a 1-line investor takeaway: "Momentum: adoption + unit economics improving month-over-month."
2) Lead with the ask (slide 1): funding runway + headcount ask should be explicit if we're seeking any approvals. If not seeking approvals, change language to "informational."

I can take the narrative top-line and slide 1/2 rewrite; will circulate a short redline by Tuesday morning so your edit window stays healthy.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Corporate Strategy
Redwood Inference

Tl;dr: timeline works and I’ll own the heatmap items. A couple quick notes:
- Risk heatmap: consolidate technical and commercial risks into a single 1-slide view with 3 mitigations and named owners.
- Please ensure any customer references are cleared by legal (I flagged slide 8 where we call out customer logos).
- If the appendix is preliminary, include a short footnote with the last refresh timestamp and who owns it.

I’ll review Jonas’ topline once he shares and add voice-of-customer bullets where appropriate.

—Laura

Thanks for the quick turns — summary of owners and timeline (finalized):
- Slide 1/2 (Topline & ask): Jonas Weber — submit redlines by Tue 10/27 10:00am PT.
- Slide 6 (OKR bridging + mitigations): Marissa Cole — finalize mitigations and owners by Tue 10/27 17:00 PT.
- Risk heatmap slide: Laura Bennett — reconcile with legal and add mitigations by Wed 10/28 11:00 PT.
- Data appendix: Marissa + Analytics — final export by Mon 10/26 17:00 PT; if delayed, mark appendix as preliminary and include refresh timestamp.
- Deck proof & export: Neha — will assemble final package Wed 10/28 afternoon and circulate to board_ops@sequoia.com for pre-read on Thu 10/29 AM.

I updated RB-Deck-v3.pptx in the Drive with a new rubric (red = ask, yellow = supporting, green = appendix) and added slide-level owner props. Please do not make manual slide deletions — leave comments so I can preserve versioning.

Related links: QBR checklist (Notion) https://notion.so/redwood/QBR-Prep-Checklist, HubSpot deal page https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-INV-2026-Q4.

If anyone needs runway on their ownership, flag to me by EOD today so I can reassign. Otherwise I’ll plan to lock and export on Wed afternoon.

Neha

Redwood Inference
